intervention_names: Other: Pharmacist Intervention in lipid therapy
arm_groups.label: Pharmacist Intervention

brief_summary: The primary objective of this research project is to compare the effect of pharmacist interventions versus usual care in the implementation of guideline directed lipid lowering therapies for secondary prevention.
brief_title: Evaluation of Pharmacist Interventions in Lipid Management for Secondary Prevention

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of coronary artery disease
* low-density lipoprotein (LDL) \> 55
* Primary Care Physician at 1 of 6 identified clinics

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who are no longer an active patient of one of the internal medicine practices
* Patients whose cholesterol is managed by another practice
* Women of childbearing age/potential
* Patients residing in hospice/Long Term Care facilities
* End-stage liver disease

official_title: Second Time's the Charm: Evaluation of Pharmacist Interventions in Lipid Management for Secondary Prevention

primary_outcomes.measure: Number of Subjects Who Meet Low-density Lipoprotein (LDL) at Goal (<55)
